description: Turun ja Kaarinan kantakartan kiintopisteet is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Turku. A detailed terrain map or base map (1:500-1:2000) forms the basis for construction, zoning and real estate formation operations, municipal engineering plans, various private maps, as well as guide and theme maps. Contents: Map items by target type. A fixed point permanently marked on the terrain. Coverage: Turku. The portal shows the English title as "Reference points for Turku and Kaarina base map" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Turku. Its keywords include maastokartat, kantakartta, Kiintopisteet. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, OGC API. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
